interpretation.conclusion: The gates pass, but the momentum control explains the lift: plain r10 beats fixed OMEGA by at least as much as the ridge does, and the ridge does not beat plain r10 — the "training lift" is momentum exposure, not learned structure. A seeded random ranker also beats fixed OMEGA, so beat-A lifts sit on a below-random baseline. Recommendation: do NOT build a ridge overlay; the repeat finding is that the fixed OMEGA score ranks poorly on its own universe (consistent with lib/omega-research-verdict.json).
